book_title: Fire Burning in My Head: A Psychologist's Self-Study Reveals How Madness May Enrich Your Life in Diverse Cultures
author: David y F Ho
book_description: The author, a Professor of Clinical of Psychology, describes how the creative energy of madness can be used to enrich one's life. The book provides psychiatric as well as ethical, political, and sociocultural contexts for understanding mental disorders in general and the author's own case in particular.
